label: Integer
description: A whole number such as a count, a quantity, or a number of affected users. Use decimal for amounts with fractions and short_text for identifiers that merely look numeric (phone numbers, serials).
usage: Set min (often 0) and max to the real-world range.
Use for values people sort, compare, or sum.
Make platform-maintained counters (e.g. reopen_count) read-only and update them from workflow transition set expressions.
constraints: Values must be whole numbers within ±9007199254740991 (JSON-safe).
min must be less than or equal to max; default must lie within them.
Decimal input is rejected, not rounded.

binding.description: Rendered by a field placement node bound to a field of this type.

accessibility.keyboard: Up/Down arrows step by 1; PageUp/PageDown step by 10; non-digit characters are rejected.
accessibility.notes: aria-valuemin/aria-valuemax reflect min/max. Numbers display with the viewer's locale grouping.

responsive: Compact width (about 12 characters) on desktop; full width below 720px.

examples.description: Read-only reopen counter maintained by the workflow
